violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:Fish cakes=44F, raw marinated chicken =44F, Scotch eggs=50F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CORRECTED. All were Iced and replaced during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: flour, and spices in unmarked containers .
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI_Containers labeled during the inspection.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical warewashing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. Then internal temperature was below 160F, when tested with a thermal plate.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. Make adjustment so that the minimum internal temperature measures 160F. In the mean time, all utensils washed at the dish machine must be sanitized mannually at the 3- compartment sink. The 3-compartment was sink set up for sanitizing, during g the inspection.
